zh: 现在AI圈最魔幻的事，
en: The strangest thing in AI right now

zh: 不是工具更新得有多快。
en: is not how fast the tools change.

zh: 是你会刷到一种很奇怪的感觉：
en: It is the strange pattern you keep seeing:

zh: 一群没有做过生意的人，
en: people who have never run a business

zh: 在教做生意的人怎么用AI赚钱。
en: teaching owners how to make money with AI.

zh: 一群没有带过团队的人，
en: People who have never led a team

zh: 在教老板怎么用AI管理团队。
en: teaching bosses how to manage one with AI.

zh: 还有一些自己手里的项目还都没有完成，
en: Some have not even finished their own projects,

zh: 还都没有跑通，
en: let alone made them work,

zh: 就已经开始讲三个月翻身、半年复制、自动成交。
en: yet already promise turnarounds, replication, and automatic sales.

zh: 老板们看到这儿啊，
en: When business owners see this,

zh: 也别批判这些人配不配讲AI。
en: do not start by judging who deserves to teach AI.

zh: 而是他们说的这套东西，
en: Ask whether what they describe

zh: 如果放进咱们自己的生意里面，
en: can be brought into your own business

zh: 到底能不能交付。
en: and actually delivered.

zh: 你就想一下对方讲的：
en: Think about the claims you hear:

zh: AI可以帮你做短视频，
en: AI can make short videos,

zh: 帮你自动回复客户，
en: automatically reply to customers,

zh: 帮你管销售，
en: manage sales,

zh: 帮你把私域跑起来。
en: and run your private traffic.

zh: 每一句好像都没有错。
en: Every sentence sounds plausible.

zh: 但是你把这套方案拉回自己的店里，
en: But bring the plan back into your own store

zh: 问题马上就变了。
en: and the questions immediately change.

zh: 你的客户从哪里进来？
en: Where do your customers come from?

zh: 咨询的问题散在哪些地方？
en: Where are their inquiries scattered?

zh: 员工哪句话经常会答错？
en: Which questions do staff often answer incorrectly?

zh: 成交失败，是客户没有看懂，
en: When a sale fails, did the customer not understand,

zh: 还是价格没有谈拢，
en: did the price negotiation fail,

zh: 还是后面的服务接不住？
en: or could the service not support the deal?

zh: 如果这些问题都没有问清楚的话，
en: If none of these questions is clarified

zh: 只给你演示一个工具界面，
en: and you only see a tool interface,

zh: 那它可能解决的不是你的生意上的问题。
en: it may not be solving your business problem.

zh: 它只是一个工具动作。
en: It is merely a tool action.

zh: 这个工具动作可以学，
en: You can learn that action,

zh: 但别把工具动作当作一个经营的建议。
en: but do not mistake it for business advice.

zh: 所以我现在看AI赚钱课，
en: So when I look at AI money-making courses

zh: 或者看AI服务方案，
en: or AI service proposals,

zh: 先看第一件事：
en: I first check one thing:

zh: 它有没有把一个真实的问题，
en: has it translated a real problem

zh: 翻译成可交付的任务？
en: into a deliverable task?

zh: 什么是可交付？
en: What does deliverable mean?

zh: 不是一句“我帮你降本增效”，
en: Not simply saying, “I will cut costs and raise efficiency.”

zh: 而是你给它什么资料，
en: It means what material you provide,

zh: 它处理哪一步，
en: which step it handles,

zh: 最后交回来什么东西，
en: what it returns,

zh: 老板拿什么验收。
en: and how the owner accepts the result.

zh: 比如客户咨询很乱，
en: If customer inquiries are chaotic,

zh: 那交付就不能只叫“AI客服系统”。
en: the deliverable cannot just be called an AI support system.

zh: 你至少要说清楚：
en: At minimum, explain clearly:

zh: 把哪些咨询整理出来，
en: which inquiries are collected,

zh: 分成哪些类型，
en: how they are categorized,

zh: 哪些客户要跟进，
en: which customers require follow-up,

zh: 哪些话术要人工确认，
en: which replies need human confirmation,

zh: 哪一类问题不能让AI自动回复。
en: and which questions AI must never answer automatically.

zh: 说到这个程度，
en: Only at this level of detail

zh: 老板才知道自己买的不是一个概念，
en: does the owner know they are buying more than a concept,

zh: 而是一段能验收的工作。
en: but a piece of work that can be accepted.

zh: 第二件事，看有没有人愿意付出成本。
en: Second: will anyone pay a real cost?

zh: 这里的成本，
en: That cost

zh: 不一定一开始就是大钱。
en: does not have to be a large payment at first.

zh: 也可能是老板们愿意拿出资料，
en: It may be an owner providing materials,

zh: 愿意让员工配合，
en: asking staff to cooperate,

zh: 愿意给一段试用的时间，
en: allowing a trial period,

zh: 愿意为一个明确的结果付一笔小预算。
en: or paying a small budget for a clear result.

zh: 很多AI内容看起来很火，
en: A lot of AI content looks popular,

zh: 其实只验证了一件事：
en: but it proves only one thing:

zh: 大家愿意看热闹。
en: people enjoy the spectacle.

zh: 点赞，不等于客户愿意付钱。
en: A like does not mean a customer will pay.

zh: 收藏，不等于老板愿意拿业务来试。
en: A save does not mean an owner will test it in business.

zh: 免费帮忙，也不等于需求真的成立。
en: Free help does not prove real demand either.

zh: 一个问题只有让对方愿意付出成本，
en: Only when someone is willing to bear a cost

zh: 才说明它在现实里有重量。
en: does the problem carry weight in reality.

zh: 第三件事，
en: Third:

zh: 看它能不能从一次服务里面沉淀出共性。
en: can one service reveal reusable patterns?

zh: 这一点很容易被忽略。
en: This is easily overlooked.

zh: 一个老板觉得有用，
en: One owner finding it useful

zh: 不代表它就是产品。
en: does not make it a product.

zh: 一个案例跑通，
en: One successful case

zh: 不代表下一个行业也能复制。
en: does not prove it can transfer to another industry.

zh: 真正有价值的部分，
en: The truly valuable part

zh: 往往是你做了几次以后发现：
en: often appears after doing the work several times:

zh: 每个老板都会问哪几类问题？
en: Which questions does every owner ask?

zh: 每次开工前都缺哪几份资料？
en: Which materials are always missing before work begins?

zh: 哪些环节必须人来确认？
en: Which steps require human confirmation?

zh: 哪些输出可以做成模板？
en: Which outputs can become templates?

zh: 哪些错误一出现，
en: Which errors, once they appear,

zh: 就说明这个方案该停下来重做？
en: mean the plan should stop and be rebuilt?

zh: 这些共性沉下来，
en: Once those patterns are preserved,

zh: AI才可能从一次演示变成一项服务。
en: AI can move from a demo to a service.

zh: 否则它就像一个会变魔术的页面，
en: Otherwise it is only a page performing a magic trick:

zh: 当场看着很厉害，
en: impressive in the room,

zh: 回到公司却没人会用。
en: but unusable back at the company.

zh: 第四件事，
en: Fourth:

zh: 也是老板们最关心的事：
en: the issue owners care about most:

zh: 出错了以后怎么办？
en: what happens when it goes wrong?

zh: AI自动回复说错话，谁检查？
en: Who checks an incorrect AI reply?

zh: 销售跟着AI话术乱承诺，谁来兜底？
en: Who owns a promise made from a bad AI sales script?

zh: 员工用了一个新的流程，
en: If staff use a new process

zh: 反而把原来的协作打乱了，
en: and disrupt the old collaboration,

zh: 那么这个谁来复盘？
en: who reviews what happened?

zh: 花了钱以后没有效果，
en: If money is spent without results,

zh: 是继续加钱，还是换工具，
en: do you spend more, switch tools,

zh: 还是停下来查原因？
en: or stop and investigate?

zh: 很多课程最愿意讲“开始”，
en: Many courses love to discuss starting

zh: 最不愿意讲“失败”。
en: and avoid discussing failure.

zh: 但对老板来说，
en: But for an owner,

zh: 不讲失败的处理方案，就是半截方案。
en: a plan without failure handling is only half a plan.

zh: 因为咱们在真实的生意里面，
en: In real business,

zh: 最贵的从来不是买工具的那一刻。
en: the most expensive moment is not buying the tool.

zh: 最贵的是买完以后没人用，
en: It is buying it and having nobody use it,

zh: 用错了没人管，
en: nobody managing errors,

zh: 管不了还要继续加钱。
en: and spending more when it cannot be managed.

zh: 所以我不是说反对AI课，
en: I am not against AI courses,

zh: 也不是说反对AI服务。
en: nor against AI services.

zh: 我反对的是那些把AI演示包装成的生意答案。
en: I oppose packaging an AI demo as a business answer.

zh: 真正靠谱的人，
en: A reliable person

zh: 不一定一上来就说自己多成功。
en: does not have to begin by claiming success.

zh: 他反而会把话说得更具体：
en: They will speak more concretely:

zh: 这件事适合谁，不适合谁。
en: who this fits and who it does not.

zh: 开始前要准备什么。
en: What must be prepared before starting.

zh: 中间哪一步必须人工确认。
en: Which step requires human confirmation.

zh: 最后用什么结果去验收。
en: Which result will be used for acceptance.

zh: 如果效果不好，
en: If the outcome is poor,

zh: 先查哪几个原因。
en: which causes should be checked first.

zh: 这种话听起来没有那么刺激，
en: This may sound less exciting,

zh: 但是对老板真的有用。
en: but it is genuinely useful to an owner.

zh: 因为生意不是短视频里的金句。
en: Business is not a catchy line in a short video.

zh: 生意是有人付成本，
en: Business means someone bears a cost,

zh: 有人交结果，
en: someone delivers a result,

zh: 有人使用，
en: someone uses it,

zh: 有人负责。
en: and someone is accountable.

zh: AI进来以后也不能跳过这些东西。
en: AI cannot skip any of these steps.

zh: 它可以让某些环节变快，
en: It can speed up certain steps,

zh: 可以让试错成本变低，
en: lower the cost of experimentation,

zh: 可以让一个小团队先做以前做不起的动作。
en: and let a small team attempt work it once could not afford.

zh: 但它不能把一个没有需求的项目变成好生意。
en: But it cannot turn a project without demand into a good business.

zh: 也不能把一个没有交付经验的人，
en: Nor can it turn someone without delivery experience

zh: 变成老板的商业顾问。
en: into a business adviser.

zh: AI圈不缺热闹。
en: The AI world has no shortage of spectacle.

zh: 普通老板真正缺的是，
en: What ordinary owners truly lack

zh: 一把能把热闹筛掉的尺子。
en: is a ruler that filters out the noise.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
